data.name: Zerubbabel
data.gender_notes: Zerubbabel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Zerubbabel is derived from the Hebrew words ‘zru’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘babel’ meaning ‘has given’. This name was given to the Jewish leader who led the reconstruction of the Second Temple in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. The name Zerubbabel represents God’s divine intervention and provision in the restoration of His people and His temple.
data.etymology: Zerubbabel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God has given.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zerubbabel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: זרובבל
in_hebrew.meaning: זרובבל הוא מי שבבל ייסד הבית השני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זרובבל בן שאלתיאל היה הנגיד על היהודים אחרי השיבה מגלות בבל. הוא הנהיג את בנייה של בית המקדש השני בירושלים והיה ממלא מקום המלך הדוד. השם זרובבל נגזר משתי מילים: 'זר' ו'בבל', שפירושן 'זרע בבל' או 'הזרע שבבל'. זרובבל היה דמות מרכזית בתקופת הבית השני והוא מוזכר בספר עזרא ונחמיה.

in_greek.name: Ζεροβابل
in_greek.meaning: Ζεροβابل ο οικοδομήσας τον δεύτερον ναόν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζεροβابل (Ζεροβαβέλ) ήταν ο αρχηγός των Εβραίων μετά την επιστροφή από την αιχμαλωσία της Βαβυλώνας. Υπήρξε ο ηγέτης της οικοδομής του Δεύτερου Ναού στην Ιερουσαλήμ και θεωρήθηκε ως διάδοχος του βασιλιά Δαβίδ. Το όνομα Ζεροβابل προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'זר' και 'בבל', που σημαίνει 'σπόρος της Βαβυλώνας'.

in_latin.name: Zerubbabel
in_latin.long_meaning: Zerubbabel filius Salathielis fuit dux Iudaeorum post reditum e captivitate Babylonica. Is fuit princeps aedificationis secundi templi Hierosolymitani et habitus est successor regis David. Nomen Zerubbabel derivatur ex vocibus 'זר' et 'בבל', quae significant 'semen Babylonis'.

in_english.name: Zerubbabel
in_english.meaning: Zerubbabel means 'seed of Babylon' or 'sprung from Babylon'
in_english.long_meaning: Zerubbabel, derived from Hebrew roots 'זר' (seed) and 'בבל' (Babylon), signifies 'seed of Babylon' or 'sprung from Babylon'. He was a Jewish leader who played a crucial role in the reconstruction of the Second Temple in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, was a prominent figure in Jewish history and is mentioned in the books of Ezra and Nehemiah. The name holds spiritual significance as a symbol of restoration and divine providence.

data.cultural_impact: Zerubbabel was a key figure in Jewish history, leading the rebuilding of the Second Temple in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. His name became synonymous with the restoration and rebuilding of God's temple and the return of the Jewish people to their homeland.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zerubbabel signifies God's faithfulness and provision in difficult times. It reminds us that even when we face challenges and exile from our spiritual home, God is still with us and will bring about restoration and renewal. The name also highlights the importance of leadership and obedience to God's call in the journey of rebuilding and restoring God's temple in our own lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zerubbabel symbolizes the rebuilding of Jerusalem and the restoration of God's temple in the heart of His people. His name means "seed of Babylon," representing the exiled Israelites returning to their homeland to rebuild and fulfill God's promises.

biblical_reference.note: Zerubbabel is mentioned as a leader of the Jews during the Second Temple period.
